problems: kingdom-of-spain: both blocking findings applied (colonies out of the 1877-1898 shapes and the Spanish Sahara/Morocco vassals ended in April 1931); all 9 non-thin fixes applied and 14 of 16 thin items worked (rulers and capitals only partly: Habsburg reigns 1516-1700 and Toledo from 1525); validator 0 errors, 8 warnings (habsburg-netherlands, spanish-sahara, spanish-morocco have no dossier; one region, the Chafarinas disc, resolves to no cell).

spanish-empire (am-06): its shapes 1516-1872 keep 30 Canary cells and, from 1582, Ceuta, which kingdom-of-spain now draws as the metropole (reviewer's fix 8); the Canaries (about 7,500 km2) and Ceuta are drawn twice unless spanish-empire subtracts them.
cuban-nationalists names kingdom-of-spain for the 1895 loss; kingdom-of-spain no longer records it (Cuba is spanish-empire's land), so cuban-nationalists should name spanish-empire.

habsburg-netherlands: eu-09 dossiers (union-of-utrecht, dutch-republic) hold the Low Countries under this name from 1579 to 1713 with no dossier, while kingdom-of-spain holds them as its own land 1516-1706 (gain from habsburg-netherlands in March 1516); one owner must be chosen.

morocco: its 1912 entry is a loss to kingdom-of-spain while kingdom-of-spain records a vassal relation to spanish-morocco (they disagree on type); morocco ledger/10, /11-12 now have mirrors in kingdom-of-spain.

kingdom-of-france has no event for the War of the Pyrenees (1794-1795), which kingdom-of-spain now records against french-first-republic; kingdom-of-portugal should mirror Olivenza (June 1801); kingdom-of-france dates the War of the Reunions to December 1683 and the War of the Reunions page to 26 October-10 November 1683.

first-spanish-republic, second-spanish-republic, francoist-spain and iberian-union have no dossier yet; the 1873/1874, 1931, 1975 and 1640 events name them as counterparts (known Cliopatria polities).
